rv.q: The terrible thing about Summerworks is that each one lasts for about a week and a half. Thankfully, Clubbed Thumb has found a way to recapture some of that lightning-in-a-bottle feeling. Last year, they revived one of their 2023 hits, Liza Birkenmeier’s shattering Grief Hotel, at the Public Theater for a short spring residency.
​"Plunkett's gripping performance is to be expected."
The heart and soul...Maryann Plunkett, who brings a convincing groundedness to her role
